checks.manager: Created actual course, date-only period and active class; enrolled seeded Student and assigned seeded Teacher via UI.
checks.teacherAssignment: Teacher created and published an actual assignment for the assigned class.
checks.studentAssignment: Student saved and finalized a real text submission; receipt displayed.
checks.teacherExam: Teacher created actual descriptive and single-choice questions and published the exam.
checks.studentExam: Student started, saved descriptive and single-choice server-versioned answers and finalized; real receipt displayed.
checks.examReload: Finalized attempt remains visible after reload; max-attempt start disabled and real receipt recovered.
checks.parent: Manager created/activated a real relation with known authorized seed identity through API; parent selected the child through UI and read the actual assignment report.
